# Mutational features

```{r signatures_pdf}
#| child: 'pcgr_quarto_report/pdf/signatures_pdf.qmd'

```

```{r kataegis_pdf}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
#| eval: !expr isTRUE(pcg_report$content$kataegis$eval)

kataegis_events_pdf <- pcg_report$content$kataegis$events
cat("## Kataegis {#pcgr-kataegis}\n\n")
cat("Kataegis describes a pattern of localized hypermutation identified in ",
    "some cancer genomes, in which a large number of highly-patterned base ",
    "substitutions occur in a small region of DNA. It is prevalent in breast ",
    "cancers, and also found in lung, cervical, head and neck, and bladder ",
    "cancers (associated with APOBEC mutational signatures). PCGR implements ",
    "the kataegis detection algorithm of the [KataegisPortal R package]",
    "(https://github.com/MeichunCai/KataegisPortal) [@Yin2020-or].\n\n",
    "- **Weight (C>X)**: proportion of C>X mutations in the region\n",
    "- **Confidence** (0-3): **0** - a hypermutation with weight C>X < 0.8; ",
    "**1** - one hypermutation with weight C>X >= 0.8 in a chromosome; ",
    "**2** - two such hypermutations in a chromosome; **3** - three or more ",
    "such hypermutations in a chromosome (high confidence)\n\n", sep = "")
if (NROW(kataegis_events_pdf) == 0) {
  cat(pcgrr:::pdf_note(kind = "empty", 
    "No potential kataegis events were identified in this tumor sample."))
}
```
